verdict.rationale: TrueLayer is an API product, so an interactive API reference is a fair question to ask. The evidence shows extensive docs, SDKs, an llms.txt index and a test-payment quickstart, but nothing describes an interactive reference with runnable or try-it-now examples. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on every candidate path. The quickstart and SDKs are adjacent features, not an interactive reference, so they earn no credit here.
